questions.question: When a widow asked the prophet Elisha for help with her debt, what did he tell her to borrow from her neighbors?
A year after Elisha promised a woman from Shunem that she would have a son, she gave birth to a boy. True or false?
After Elisha shut the door of the room where the Shunem woman's dead son lay, what did he do?
After Elisha stretched himself out a second time over the dead son of the woman from Shunem, what happened?

answers.text: The boy sneezed seven times and opened his eyes
The boy sat up and called for his mother
The boy groaned and asked for his father
